timing.title: Window: now → Nov 11 — earnings Nov 12 (28d)
points: Earnings 2026-11-12 (28d out) land AFTER this expiry — the term structure prices a ±16% move. Holding isn't exposed — but anything you roll beyond it is a bet on the print, and back-month IV carries the event, which is exactly why an even-cost roll looks so easy.
Cleanest: Nov 6 (22d) — it ends BEFORE the print (#7 of 19, 46/100).
Best roll through the print: Nov 20 (36d, 34/100) — its $100 short sits 23.5% from spot vs ±16% priced: outside the move (≈7% odds the print alone takes it out).
Premium is thin vs realized (IV 80.0% vs HV 85.0%) — re-selling time now is poorly paid; if nothing forces you, a vol bump is the better moment to roll.
